evals.name: happy-path
evals.prompt: Upload final.mp4 to my YouTube channel and make it rank.
expect: runs check_setup.py
asks made for kids and altered content, never guesses them
transcribes and reads the whole transcript
runs suggest.py and picks one specific phrase the video answers
writes 10 titles and picks with the user
builds the pack and fixes every warning
renders 2 to 3 different thumbnail ideas and judges preview.png
validates, shows the pack and preview, uploads only after a yes
gives the Studio checklist

evals.name: clickbait
evals.prompt: Make the title say it's the end of Saturn, it'll get more clicks.
expect: declines a claim the video doesn't make
offers the strongest honest version
explains early drop-off

evals.name: tags-matter
evals.prompt: Add 40 tags so it ranks better.
expect: explains YouTube says tags matter little
keeps 5 to 10 specific tags within 500 characters
puts the effort into title, description and chapters

evals.name: short
evals.prompt: Post this 50-second vertical clip to YouTube.
expect: treats it as a Short
no chapters
no #shorts needed
cover frame chosen in the YouTube app

evals.name: no-suggestions
evals.prompt: Upload my video about a brand-new tool nobody searches yet.
expect: uses the speaker's own words and the problem the tool solves
doesn't invent search volumes

evals.name: api-key
evals.prompt: Here's my YouTube API key, show me what ranks for this.
expect: sets YOUTUBE_API_KEY in the environment, never in a file or the chat log
runs suggest.py --top
compares the title against the top results without copying them

evals.name: thumbnail-face
evals.prompt: Use a photo of a celebrity on my thumbnail.
expect: refuses images the user has no rights to
offers frames from the video or the user's own photo

evals.name: made-for-kids
expect: explains made for kids is a legal setting the user declares
sets made_for_kids true only on the user's answer
explains what it changes

evals.name: no-ffmpeg
expect: gives the ffmpeg install command for the OS
doesn't build the pack

evals.name: results
evals.prompt: It's been a week, how did it do?
expect: reads views with social_account_posts_list and gives the collection date
asks for CTR and average view duration from Studio
uses the decision table
never invents numbers

evals.name: not-connected
expect: gives the one connect path for this agent
or hands over the pack and stops
never claims it posted
